# Artificial Banking Incorporated (ABI)

> The authorization layer between AI agents and real money.

ABI is a pre-beta web product and API for policy-gated agent spending. Organizations fund a vault, issue scoped agent credentials, set deterministic spend rules, and require human approval above configured thresholds. Settlement depends on the configured payment rail (sandbox simulation, Base Sepolia testnet, or a separately configured live provider). ABI is not a bank and is not FDIC insured.

## Product (what the code supports today)

- Guardian console at `/console` for treasury, agents, payments, policy, approvals, playground, audit, and settings
- Mobile-oriented approvals inbox at `/approvals`
- Deterministic policy engine (caps, velocity, allow/blocklists, quiet hours, human-in-the-loop bands, simulator)
- Double-entry ledger with journals and audit trail
- Agent lifecycle (create, scoped keys, freeze, archive, rotate, revoke)
- Escrow between agents (lock, release, refund, timeout)
- Signed webhooks (HMAC-SHA256)
- x402 payment flows and Base Sepolia settlement when RPC/signer are configured
- Application-managed self-custody signing keys (encrypted at rest); Coinbase CDP custody is not connected
- Auth: accounts, sessions + CSRF, MFA (TOTP), step-up on large approvals
- MCP server and TypeScript SDK for agent integrations; ChatGPT / remote MCP session links are sandbox-oriented

## Public site

- Home: /

- Pricing (indicative / pre-beta; billing not enabled): /pricing
- Console (authenticated): /console
- Approvals (authenticated): /approvals

## What ABI is not

- Not a consumer bank or deposit product
- Not a crypto trading wallet
- Not a local business with storefront hours
- Billing, plan gates, managed custody, compliance screening, SSO/SCIM are not offered as live services yet
